descriptions.text: A second exploit drained VerusCoin's Ethereum Bridge for $7.54 million, following a similar $11.6 million hack in May - same bridge, a different gap in the same broken trust boundary. This time there was no statement, no bounty, just silence.

Verus<>Ethereum bridge drained via 11-of-15 Notaries with compromised private keys used to authorize malicious state root; attacker submitted crafted cross-chain proofs with abnormally shallow Merkle paths (3 segments vs 17 legitimate) through submitImports() to release ~1.14K ETH, 71.5 tBTC, 59.4 MKR, USDC/USDT/DAI/EUROC/scrvUSD from bridge reserves; code lacked proof-depth validation and branchType enforcement. Attack Tx: https://etherscan.io/tx/0xa1f1e65c1cea4dba4ae439cd4dcdba6cc2dbda0ed1228e61f29ae9c9324eb099 Source: https://twitter.com/DefimonAlerts/status/2080271385713066152
